entries.name: Acorn Truffle
entries.description: A favourite food of many forest animals, this hardy truffle is prized by druids and rangers.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * In (some) barrels in the Apothecary's Cellar in Act 1

entries.name: Balsam
entries.description: Since balsam thrives on high mountaintops, the petals of this spindly flower can be carried for miles on a strong wind.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Growing in the wild * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark

entries.name: Autumncrocus
entries.description: Legend says the first crocus was created by Lathander, the Morninglord, which is why this delicate flower is always found stretching its petals towards the sun.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * Random loot throughout the game

entries.name: Behir Scales
entries.description: Parabolas of lightning spark around the corners of this hard, smooth scale.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold in Act Three by: ** Horst at the Velveteen Elixir ** Popper at the Circus of the Last Days (occasionally)

entries.name: Beholder Iris
entries.description: Even glazed over in death, the eye's colour is vibrant and menacing.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by: ** Mystic Carrion ** Popper ** Stylin' Horst

entries.name: Bixa Root
entries.description: This tough, inflexible reed grows in waterside clusters and makes for a fine building material.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Three can be found in the garden of the House of Grief, along with two other Mergrass variants; Poppy Flower and Valerian Flower.

entries.name: Belladonna
entries.description: The old rhyme goes, 'If you fear the changer moon / If befall'd by curse or doom / If you're in the lycan's power / Seek the Belladonna flower.' Old rhymes are pretty but they get people killed more often than not. Belladonna blooms are poisonous.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by various merchants throughout the game, such as Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * Growing in the wild throughout the game, including at 247.

entries.name: Black Oleander
entries.description: Oft planted near graveyards and gifted to the sickest of patients, black oleander is believed to keep necrosis from spreading.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Various places on the Ruined Battlefield

entries.name: Bonecap
entries.description: An acidic, foul-tasting mushroom that can be found anywhere bodies have been buried. Or left to rot.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * On a dead Myconid at -146 * Various places in the wilderness

entries.name: Bullywug Trumpet
entries.description: A sour, unappetising mushroom, the Bullywug Trumpet is found anywhere dark and dank.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Commonly in the underground and Underdark * In the Enclave Library * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark

entries.name: Broken Machinery
entries.description: The cogs of this metal contraption are bent out of shape, the steel sheeting dented and cracked. Still, you can make out two sets of initials embossed into the copper: LDH and YTS.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * In the Arcane Tower in the Underdark ** Five are out on the top floor of the tower ** The rest are in containers on the entry floor (including a container on the south balcony)

entries.name: Carrion Crawler Tentacle
entries.description: Waxy-white slime excretes from the pores of this prehensile tentacle.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * In Balthazar's Outpost in the Gauntlet of Shar * Sold by merchants in Act Three (rarely) * Dead Crabs on the Grey Harbour Docks

entries.name: Chasm Creeper
entries.description: These rare crystals can only be found at the edges of expansive chasms, where they cling stubbornly to vertical stone.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Can be found around the paths of the Underdark, and are easily recognised as they emit a purple glow

entries.name: Crystalline Lens
entries.description: When Held up to moonlight the lens seems to shift, as if its glass core reacts to the scant light of evening.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Carried by Scrying Eye (creature) * At several points in the Arcane Tower * Sold by some merchants in Act Three

entries.name: Corpse Rose
entries.description: Missing its bottom jaw. And its body.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * In the Brewer's Alchemist stash (4x) * Near a grave at 57 in Act Two * Carried by Balthazar in the Gauntlet of Shar * At the Graveyard (Lower City) * Sold by: ** Derryth Bonecloak in Myconid Colony in the Underdark (starting at Level 9){{verify}} ** Popper at the Circus of the Last Days ** Stylin' Horst in Wyrm's Crossing ** Zethino at the Circus of the Last Days

entries.name: Cloud Giant Finger
entries.description: The blood on this finger has clotted in strange swirling patterns - like a grotesque facsimile of cumulus clouds.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by various merchants throughout the game, including (but not limited to): ** Act 1 *** Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony (Underdark) starting at Level 6 (25% chance) *** Blurg at the Myconid Colony (Underdark) after reaching Level 6 ** Act 2 *** Hoarding Merregon inside the Gauntlet of Shar *** In the Brewer's Alchemist stash ** Act 3 *** Mystic Carrion in the Lower City *** Stylin' Horst at his Potion Shop in Wyrm's Crossing *** Bareki, next to the Undercity Ruins waypoint

entries.name: Daggerroot
entries.description: Known as 'the executioner's garnish', this herb flourishes in blood-fed soil and has flavoured countless final meals.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Found growing in the wild on the Ravaged Beach, among various other locations. * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark and various other merchants later throughout the game

entries.name: Divine Bone Shard
entries.description: The hairs on your arms stand on end each time you touch this remnant of a once-god.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * 1x {{-}} Carried by Zar'an in the Hatchery at Crèche Y'llek * 2x {{-}} in the Astral Plane upon entering it at Crèche Y'llek * 3x {{-}} in the Astral Plane upon entering it at the start of Act Three when being ambushed by Githyanki, two on islands floating around the skull, and one on the skull island where Orpheus is imprisoned * 1x {{-}} inside a wooden trunk in a shed north of The Velveteen Elixir at Wyrm's Crossing * Sold by various merchants once the party reaches sufficient level, including: ** Bareki at the Undercity Ruins in the Lower City Sewers ** Derryth Bonecloak (after Level 6) in the Underdark ** Helsik in the Devil's Fee in the Lower City ** Popper at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington ** Thrumbo at Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City

entries.name: Dragon Egg Mushroom
entries.description: It's unclear whether the beautiful patterns on these mushrooms are the result of magic or nature, but the fungus is often sought out by smiths, who mix it into a paste to prevent burns.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Found throughout the game * Sold by various merchants throughout the game including, Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark

entries.name: Eagle Feather
entries.description: One of thousands of feathers adorning a giant eagle, you can only hope this graced an elegant part of the bird, such as the wing, and not an indignant part, such as the left armpit.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Carried by Giant Eagles and Ancient Giant Eagles

entries.name: Fire Amber
entries.description: Lambent from within, these crystals are the very progenitors of flame.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by various merchants after the party has sufficiently progressed throughout the game, such as Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * In the basement and third floor of Felogyr's Fireworks

entries.name: Frost Salamander Tongue
entries.description: Thanks to their mindless appetite for heat, frost salamanders are often tricked by bronze-forged azers. The azers set a campfire blazing, and the salamanders slither toward it hungrily, only to be ripped apart for their alchemically valuable tongues.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Brewer's Alchemist stash - the exact location of which can be found in The Waning Moon from notes; it is dug up from under a Dirt Mound in a patch underneath a house between House of Healing and road to Baldur's Gate entrance to the south * Another tongue can be found in the "Offering to Mystra" box in the basement of Stormshore Tabernacle * Sold by Helsik at the Devil's Fee * Sold by Thrumbo at Philgrave's Mansion

entries.name: Frosted Ear
entries.description: Were it not for its determination not to melt and distinguishable (almost human) earlobe, this might well be a normal chunk of ice.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by various merchants

entries.name: Gauth Eyestalk
entries.description: Though noticeably smaller than a beholder's, gauth's eyestalks can likewise shoot terrifying rays. Luckily this one has long perished.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by merchants later in the game, including: ** Blurg in The Lodge of the Lower City ** Popper the kobold in Rivington ** Stylin' Horst in Rivington * One is located in Balthazar's room in the Gauntlet of Shar * One is located in a room north of Stylin' Horst's Potion Shop in Rivington

entries.name: Gremsihka Tail
entries.description: When a feckless spellcaster attempts to create life and bungles it, the result is a gremishka. Spiteful and malformed, gremishkas hold a particular loathing for practitioners of the arcane arts, a dark reflection of typical parental love.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Carried by Gremishka (creature) * Sold by merchants later in the game

entries.name: Harpy Feather
entries.description: This feather is surprisingly soft and well-maintained.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Three can be looted from Rocky's sarcophagus in the Durinbold Mausoleum. * One can be found near a large nest on the northwestern roof of the House of Healing, along with some other ingredients.

entries.name: Hastening Spores
entries.description: These spores sprint about in lively cyclic patterns, tiny runners on a fungal track.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Sold by: * Derryth Bonecloak and Blurg at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark upon reaching Level 6 * Horst at The Velveteen Elixir in Wyrm's Crossing * Mystic Carrion and Thrumbo at Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City * Sticky Dondo in the Guildhall in the Undercity

entries.name: Heart-Shaped Rock
entries.description: Upon death, a magma mephit's cardiac system floods with sulphur, cooling and hardening it into a vulcanised geode aglitter with scarlet stone.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Carried by Magma Mephits * Carried by the Lava Elemental (creature)

entries.name: Hill Giant Finger
entries.description: Thanks to the finger's vast size, each spot of fungus, mud, and flesh stuck beneath its fingernail is agonisingly clear.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by various merchants throughout the game, including (but not limited to) Derryth Bonecloak and Blurg at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark

entries.name: Hyena Ear
entries.description: Soft, patchy and ragged, the ears are one of the most appealing parts of a hyena's corpse.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * In alchemy labs * Carried by Hyena and Gnoll * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark

entries.name: Imp Patagium
entries.description: A red membrance that once spanned an imp's wings. Up close, you can see tiny black veins that once supplied the fiend with blood and power.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Sold by:Stock randomly renews for these vendors over long rests. * Sticky Dondo in the Guildhall at 755 * Bareki in the Undercity Ruins at 936

entries.name: Hook
entries.description: A bone hook splattered with blood. It is cold and sharp, like a whetted blade.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Carried by Hook Horror (creature) * Sold by Popper

entries.name: Intellect Devourer Cerebellum
entries.description: Intellect Devourers are born of the brains of humanoid mind flayer thralls. So what is it, exactly, that you are holding in your hands?
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Omeluum at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * On Intellect Devourers and Intellect Gluttons

entries.name: Laculite
entries.description: This crystal was formed in the twisting, murky waters within the Underdark. Often mined by Deep Gnomes, though considered less valuable than their preferred rubies.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * On the beach at the Decrepit Village in the Underdark

entries.name: Lolth's Candle
entries.description: Glowing stones that flicker in the darkness. Some travellers find themselves following these lights, thinking they might have found a friendly fellow wanderer.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Several can be found in the Bibberbang field west of the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * One can be found in the Arcane Tower on the table by the garden entrance to the tower * One can be found on the corpse of Xargrim at -90

entries.name: Ki-Rin Hair
entries.description: Many view ki-rin as heralds of good fortune, and for good reason - even the tiniest strand of their hair holds a wealth of benevolent magic.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by various merchants later in the game, such as Blurg and Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark, after reaching Level 6

entries.name: Mergrass
entries.description: This tough, inflexible reed grows in waterside clusters and makes for a fine building material.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * On the Ravaged Beach

entries.name: Night Orchid
entries.description: Night Orchid is an Alchemical Ingredient. Combine 3 of these to create a Solution of Night Orchid, which is used to make Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Throughout the Ruined Battlefield, including at 175, 35, and 104 * Sold by Popper * In the hidden Night Orchid Cave within the Cloister of Sombre Embrace

entries.name: Nightlight
entries.description: A mere remnant of a living light source.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Harvested from Nightlight mushrooms in the Underdark with 12 * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * On a dead Myconid at -146

entries.name: Mud Mephit Wing
entries.description: Formed out of soft clay and mud, this wing is already starting to fall apart.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by various merchants throughout the game, including Blurg and Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * Dropped by Mud Mephits

entries.name: Mugwort
entries.description: A bane of farmers and gardeners, this quick-growing weed reappears mere days after being cut.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * In alchemy labs and abandoned homes, such as Old Garlow's Place in the Lower City * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark

entries.name: Nothic Eye
entries.description: Gazing glassily up at you, bereft of humanity, this bulbous eye evokes the gruesome curse of the nothics. For they were not always monsters, but wizards who groped too greedily for power.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark

entries.name: Ochre Jelly Slime
entries.description: Undulations throb through this ooze, giving it the look of a larval sack imbued with hideous animation.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Carried by Ochre Jelly * Sold by some merchants later in the game

entries.name: Owlbear Beak
entries.description: Careful, this owlbear still has some bite.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * One can be looted from Zina's sarcophagus in the Durinbold Mausoleum.

entries.name: Pegasus Feather
entries.description: This feather would make the softest duck down feel like hedgehog quills.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by various merchants once the party has sufficiently progressed in level in the game, including Blurg and Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark

entries.name: Poison Spore
entries.description: Although they abhor violence, myconids boast both poisonous gas pockets and pulverizing limbs - a clear indicator that the harsh reality of the Underdark has equipped them with defensive capabilities, should that abhorrence slacken.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * On a dead Myconid at -146

entries.name: Planetar Feather
entries.description: This ivory quill could be mistaken for a plain eagle feather, if not for the power pulsating off it in waves.

entries.name: Poppy Flower
entries.description: This tough, inflexible reed grows in waterside clusters and makes for a fine building material.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Three can be found in the garden of the House of Grief, along with two other Mergrass variants; Bixa Root and Valerian Flower. One can also be found at the base of the stairs leading to the Mortuary at the east end of the Graveyard (Lower City).

entries.name: Purple Worm Gullet
entries.description: Tiny veins of gemstone marble the gullet - evidence of the worm's unique (and highly toxic) digestive system.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * In the backroom of the Waning Moon * Sold by Popper

entries.name: Shadowroot Sac
entries.description: A small sac harvested from a faintly glowing mushroom. It smells incomprehensibly vile.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Can be found throughout the Shadow-Cursed Lands

entries.name: Putrefied Tumour
entries.description: Whatever corpse this fetid cancer was once attached to has long rotted away, leaving only its affliction behind.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Carried by various creatures in the Shadow-Cursed Lands

entries.name: Silk Gland
entries.description: Thick and bloodied, this fleshy sack is plump and fresh.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * Carried by Phase Spider and the Phase Spider Matriarch

entries.name: Rogue's Morsel
entries.description: Frequently referenced in tales of roguish adventures, this mushroom can be quite the boon for those who know how to use it.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * In alchemy labs and in the wilderness

entries.name: Sylvan Stone
entries.description: Found where the Feywild touches the Material Plane, these crystals are warm to the touch, as if they've been basking in the Feywild's ever-setting sun.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak and Blurg at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * Overgrown Tunnel, the hag's lair; many of them can be found near the Mushroom Circle, which teleports its users to the Underdark

entries.name: Timmask Spores
entries.description: Spores are the Timmask's main defence system, poisoning and befuddling any who inhale them.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by: ** Omeluum at the Ebonlake Grotto in the Underdark ** Blurg at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark after reaching Level 6 * In the Arcane Tower in the Underdark * On Timmask mushrooms in the Underdark

entries.name: Tongue of Madness
entries.description: This long, slender mushroom is named both for its resemblance to an oversized human tongue and the effect it has on that organ when consumed.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by the following merchants at higher character levels: ** Auntie Ethel at the Riverside Teahouse in the Wilderness ** Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark ** Omeluum at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark ** Popper at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington * On the First floor (Greenhouse) and in the basement of the Arcane Tower in the Underdark

entries.name: Swarming Toadstool
entries.description: Often found swarming around larger fungi, the Swarming Toadstool can grow anywhere it can find some company.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Throughout the game, most commonly in the Underdark * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark. * In the Brewer's Alchemist stash in a dirt mound in a patch underneath a house between the House of Healing and the road to Baldur's Gate entrance to the south of Reithwin

entries.name: Venomous Fang
entries.description: A sheen of clear poison coats this fang, like a wasp's autumnal stinger.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark

entries.name: Viridian Crystal
entries.description: Known as 'Fool's Emerald', Viridian Crystal is a brittle, sharp crystal that is difficult to craft but has some uses in alchemy.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Can be found in the Underdark * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark.

entries.name: Valerian Flower
entries.description: This tough, inflexible reed grows in waterside clusters and makes for a fine building material.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Three can be found in the garden of the House of Grief, along with two other Mergrass variants; Bixa Root and Poppy Flower.

entries.name: Unicorn Horn
entries.description: The unicorn's blood is dried to the ivory base, defiling the holy magic of the beast's horn.

entries.name: Weavemoss
entries.description: Colloquially known as Wizard's Beard, this lichen can grow wherever the Weave is strong.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by various merchants throughout the game, such as Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * Random loot throughout the game

entries.name: Wood Bark
entries.description: Twisted and knobbled in nodes of hardened sap, the grain of this bark manages to be both rough and smooth to the touch.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by: ** Blurg and Derryth Bonecloak in the Myconid Colony in the Underdark ** Other merchants throughout the game * Carried by: ** Blight ** Shambling Mound ** Wood Woad

entries.name: Wispweed
entries.description: Spurned by unrequited loves, young men often get drunk and wander into the swamps like Silverwisp along the Sword Coast. Some vanish. This plant is rumoured to be strands of hair from their drowned scalps.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Sold by Derryth Bonecloak at the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * Random loot throughout the game

entries.name: Worg Fang
entries.description: This fang stinks of rotting flesh and death - the remnants of this worg's many hunts.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Carried by Worgs * Sold by certain traders, such as Derryth Bonecloak in the Myconid Colony in the Underdark * Always restocked by Olak, Puce, Rindle, and Bal who are guarding the entrance to the Goblin Camp

entries.name: Xorn Scales
entries.description: Though consisting mostly of plain rock, these thick scales have a crystalline shine no stone on the Material Plane possesses.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Various merchants

entries.name: Wyvern Stinger
entries.description: Strings of dry gristly sinew cling to the attenuated stump of this stinger.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Brewer's Alchemist stash in the Waning Moon

entries.name: Yellow Musk Creeper Petals
entries.description: Don't be fooled by the attractive musky scent these petals produce - these flowers feast on humanoid corpses.

entries.name: Ashes of Balsam
entries.description: These partially burned balsam leaves exude a smoky, sweet fragrance.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Balsam

entries.name: Ashes of Dried Fey Flower
entries.description: Floral needles of scent thread the air around this extract with the smell of honeysuckle, balmy eucalyptus, croacus and cyclamen.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Inside a safe in Old Garlow's Place

entries.name: Ashes of Dragon Egg Mushroom
entries.description: It is one of life's small ironies that the first step in creating an Elixir of Fire Resistance includes burning its main ingredient.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Dragon Egg Mushrooms

entries.name: Ashes of Fire Amber
entries.description: Crackling, stinging sparks leap from these cinder when you stir them with a finger - but the ashes themselves remain almost unnaturally cold.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Fire Ambers

entries.name: Ashes of Daggerroot
entries.description: Often fed with the blood of the fallen, daggerroot is said to help create new victims - a property that only intensifies once the plant has been dried and burned.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Daggerrouts.

entries.name: Ashes of Mephit Magma
entries.description: The oil refined from these ashes will act as a catalyst for the prettiest bursts of furnace-hot flame.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Heart Shaped Rocks

entries.name: Ashes of Hyena Ear
entries.description: Molten earwax clings to the ashes, turning the whole into a sticky goo.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Hyena Ears

entries.name: Ashes of Imp Patagium
entries.description: Native to the Nine Hells, imps barely burn, but once they have perished, their wings turn to ash surprisingly easily.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Imp Patagium

entries.name: Ashes of Worg Fang
entries.description: Worgs, unlike phoenixes, do not rise from the ashes - but their savagery does.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Worg Fangs

entries.name: Essence of Acorn Truffle
entries.description: Like the truffle it is extracted from, this spirit's vibrant colour and smell seem to entice all kinds of critters.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Acorn Truffles

entries.name: Essence of Beholder Eye
entries.description: This vivid resin gleams with the promise of power.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Beholder Irises

entries.name: Ashes of Wyvern Stinger
entries.description: Far more bestial than their draconic cousins, Wyverns fill the sky with shrieks like some nightmarish airborne choir, their stingers adrip with beats of poison.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Wyvern Stingers

entries.name: Essence of Crystalline Lens
entries.description: Catching the eye, a few quartzy grains of crystal linger.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Crystalline Lenses

entries.name: Essence of Planetar Feather
entries.description: Ivory with the slightest hint of emerald - and thrumming with magic.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Planetar Feathers

entries.name: Essence of Gremishka Tail
entries.description: Discorporated from its shape, the tail essence gestures to the futility and endurance of conflict between spellcasters and their more sentient failures.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Gremishka Tails

entries.name: Essence of Nightlight
entries.description: In his troubled Underdark days, the drow with the heart of gold, Drizzt Do'Urden, often purified nightlight to draw out its luminance. By its light his face was pensive, thoughtful, and too-wise.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Crafted by combining 3 Nightlight Fronds

entries.name: Essence of Swarming Toadstool
entries.description: Cheerfully dancing motes of bioluminescence, reduced to their fundamental matter.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Swarming Toadstools

entries.name: Essence of Sylvan Stone
entries.description: The belief that the Feywild is a dreamy plane of whimsical adventure is folly. The occasional rainbow-coloured glint from this substance could easily evoke a treacherous oil slick.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Sylvan Stones

entries.name: Essence of Timmask Spores
entries.description: The chaotic fugue of Timmask-induced confusion is in many ways the exact opposite of Myconid meditation, which is calm, spiritual, and does not involve even a little bit of puzzled drooling.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Timmask Spores

entries.name: Salts of Carrion Crawler Tentacle
entries.description: While crows rend gobbets of flesh from battlefield dead, carrion crawlers prefer the seclusion of sewers and cemeteries for their feasting.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Carrion Crawler Tentacles

entries.name: Essence of Unicorn Horn
entries.description: Remember this, as you hold these heavenly sparks: any creature that takes a role in the death of a unicorn risks incurring divine wrath.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Unicorn Horns

entries.name: Salts of Cloud Giant Fingernails
entries.description: Despotic, artistic, and terribly powerful, cloud giants often view themselves as elegant sovereigns over the cruder, more terrestrial giantkin.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Cloud Giant Fingers

entries.name: Salts of Chasm Creeper
entries.description: The lonely tenacity of the Chasm Creeper might go some way to explaining its alchemical properties - strength like that could be useful when harnessed.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Chasm Creepers

entries.name: Salts of Corpse Rose
entries.description: Once plucked from the chest cavity of a recent corpse, this flower was dried and mixed with rare salts to enhance its alchemical properties.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Corpse Roses

entries.name: Salts of Copper Shavings
entries.description: These tiny slivers of copper glisten when illuminated - almost like miniature bolts of lightning.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Broken Machineries

entries.name: Salts of Musk Creeper
entries.description: While alive, yellow musk creepers feed on humanoid corpses, turning them into zombies, but in the hands of a skilled alchemist, their petals can be used for good.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Yellow Musk Creeper Petals

entries.name: Salts of Mugwort
entries.description: The roots of the common mugwort weed can be dried and crushed to create a powder that looks unassuming, but is full of potential.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Mugworts

entries.name: Salts of Hill Giant Fingernails
entries.description: These salts have a surprisingly vast colour palette - the yellows of fungus, greens of moss, and blacks and browns of old blood.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Hill Giant Fingers

entries.name: Salts of Rogue's Morsel
entries.description: Created using the dried gills of the rogue's morsel mushroom, this powder smells surprisingly sweet.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Rogue's Morsels

entries.name: Salts of Viridian Crystal
entries.description: Inchoate arcane symbols form and dissolve in the salt grains.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Viridian Crystals

entries.name: Solution of Night Orchid
entries.description: This liquid solution has the colour of evening.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Night Orchids

entries.name: Salts of Tree Bark
entries.description: Unlike malignant blights, wood woads are created to fulfil a specific purpose. Considering the brutality of the ceremony by which they are made, the derived elixir will doubtless make one hardy and staunch as bark.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Wood Bark

entries.name: Salts of Xorn Scales
entries.description: These ground xorn scales would be indistinguishable from a pile of sand, if not for their otherworldly shine.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Xorn Scales

entries.name: Sublimate of Autumn Crocus
entries.description: The airily sweet mist makes you light-headed, feeling like you could reach for the sun.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Autumncrocus

entries.name: Sublimate of Bloodstained Hook
entries.description: Few Sounds in the vast Underdark are as eerie as the clacking, echoing chatter of Hook Horrors - made even worse by the fact that they are usually a warning of even greater danger to come.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Hooks

entries.name: Sublimate of Behir Scales
entries.description: Ironically, the blinding property of behir scales mirrors the short-sightedness of the storm giants who created the first behirs - fashioned from serpentine lightning, they did not remain subordinate to their giant masters for long.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Behir Scales

entries.name: Sublimate of Belladonna
entries.description: In this transmogrified state, Belladonna loses its toxic properties, gaining instead an engrossing, perception-enhancing characteristic.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Belladonna

entries.name: Sublimate of Frosted Ears
entries.description: Ice mephit ears boast the alchemical property of nullifying fire resistance. Though completely useless to the mephits itself, they seem to revel in the thought of imparting their own vulnerabilities onto others.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Frosted Ears

entries.name: Sublimate of Haste Spores
entries.description: A frenzy of tiny mushroom-shaped clouds fizzle and pop on the surface of this sublimate.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Hastening Spores

entries.name: Sublimate of Ki-Rin Hair
entries.description: The smoke coming from ki-rin hair releases a soothing scent, as well as the bulk of its heavenly magic.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Ki-Rin Hair

entries.name: Sublimate of Eagle Feathers
entries.description: Eagles have been known to kill tortoises by gripping them by the shell, taking flight, and dropping them from a great height. No one knows why they do this, because there isn't particularly good eating on a tortoise.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Eagle Feathers

entries.name: Sublimate of Pegasus Feathers
entries.description: Pegasi hail from Arborea. There they serve elven gods, their wings spread like broad fans over lush gardens, and their feathers bright with blessings and powers of vitality.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Pegasus Feathers

entries.name: Sublimate of Poison Spores
entries.description: One whiff of this sickly-sweet smelling vapour makes the sinuses shrink.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Poison Spores

entries.name: Sublimate of Tongue of Madness
entries.description: The suffusion of psionics through the nervous system is generally a slow, perhaps even generational process, as the gith and duergar might well attest to.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Tongues of Madness

entries.name: Sublimate of Wispweed
entries.description: Get the strands wet and you can almost hear the lovelorn sobs.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Wispweeds

entries.name: Suspension of Frost Salamander Tongue
entries.description: The gelid texture of this substance is a reflection of the frost giants who tame equally icy salamanders at the intersection between Planes of Air and Water.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Frost Salamander Tongues

entries.name: Suspension of Cerebrospinal Fluid
entries.description: This fluid, harvested from a humanoid brain enthralled and experimented on by mind flayers until it gained a life of its own, is the perfect ingredient for psychic potions.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Intellect Devourer Cerebellums

entries.name: Suspension of Bullywug Trumpet
entries.description: Even the slightest sniff of this acrid tincture makes your eyes sting.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Bullywug Trumpets

entries.name: Suspension of Gauth Eye
entries.description: Once used to wet a Gauth's eye, this slime had mostly dried up before you could extract it. Still, its power remains.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Gauth Eyestalks

entries.name: Suspension of Muddy Goo
entries.description: Nothing but a watery sludge remains of what was once a mephit's wing. Still, its elemental magic lingers.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Mud Mephit Wings

entries.name: Suspension of Laculite
entries.description: Crushed Laculite floats at the bottom of this tincture, infusing the water with the Underdark's mysterious powers.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Laculites

entries.name: Suspension of Mergrass
entries.description: Touching a little of the substance to your lips, you begin to hear muffled pulses of sound - daubs of thoughts belonging to those nearby.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Mergrasses

entries.name: Suspension of Nothic Eye
entries.description: The origin of the nothic curse is one-eyed Vecna, the undead lich and master of secrets. Nothics themselves do not remember their former livers as wizards - but their eyes can still be distilled for the benefit of spellcasters.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Nothic Eyes

entries.name: Suspension of Purple Worm Slime
entries.description: Purple Worms are attracted by sonic vibrations. Drow and duergar settlements erect special arcane barriers to deter the incursion of these frightful monsters.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: Crafted by combining 3 Purple Worm Gullets

entries.name: Suspension of Snake Venom
entries.description: Poison is believed to be the coward's tool, but the soldier who works with so-called honest steel might reconsider this opinion if her sword reared up and bit her on the eyeball.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Venomous Fangs

entries.name: Suspension of Ochre Jelly
entries.description: If Iggwilv's Demonomicon has the right of it, all oozes are the spawn of the Faceless Lord, the demon tyrant Juiblex - it also cites the useful motion-based alchemical properties of the substance.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Ochre Jelly Slimes

entries.name: Suspension of Spider Silk
entries.description: Once, there were songs of Ettercap (creature)s and spiders that warded children away from dangerous woods - but songs are forgotten, children wander, and when the silken threads turn out to be stickier than first presumed, their small noises of surprise are abruptly silenced.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Silk Glands

entries.name: Vitriol of Bonecap
entries.description: Bonecaps are found growing upon burial grounds; their alchemical properties are flavored with proximal death.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Bonecaps

entries.name: Vitriol of Lolth's Candle
entries.description: No surprise that Lolth's candle lead travellers in the Underdark, given that their namesake is a goddess of deceit as well as spiders and shadows. Worse, distilled, they even blind and poison the unwary.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Lolth's Candles

entries.name: Vitriol of Divine Miasma
entries.description: A thick miasma exuded by the bone shards of a dead god. For some inexplicable reason, it makes you feel safe.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Divine Bone Shards

entries.name: Vitriol of Oleander
entries.description: The sap's dark colour, viscous consistency, and cloying sweetness belie its beneficial potential.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Black Oleanders

entries.name: Vitriol of Shadowroot Sac
entries.description: A cloying sweetness rises from the secretion. It simultaneously sharpens your senses and makes bile rise in your throat.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Shadowroot Sacs

entries.name: Vitriol of Putrefied Tumour
entries.description: The stench of this rotten flesh has only worsened during its journey through the alchemical process.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Putrefied Tumours

entries.name: Vitriol of Weavemoss
entries.description: Small parts of Weave stick to this foul-smelling paste, imperceptible to any but the most attuned spellcasters.
entries.alchemyWhereToFind: * Crafted by combining 3 Weavemoss
